title: A space has elements; a project ties elements across rooms; the building's elements stay (2026-11-27)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
If I look at the front door, the front door has a set of elements to it, and we want to be able to group the ideas around the elements. [...] So the creation of the bounty game has elements across different parts of the whole. [...] So there are elements that work across the different rooms, tied together to a project.

[...] Each of these sections should be added to the map of the building because they're consistent and will generally remain there.

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in a Claude Code session, 2026-11-27 (14:46 and 14:56), about The Party Utility season 5 backstage map. Verbatim excerpts; the list of particular elements and tasks in the same messages is not recorded here (it went into the repository as passes elements-projects and building-elements). Backfilled 2026-11-27 by a later session: the original session applied it to the house rules but did not record it.
